Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Sunnyvale Bowling Club operates as a recreational facility offering bowling lanes and associated activities, with a focus on providing a safe and enjoyable environment for patrons. The club maintains robust financial health, ensuring stable cash flow and reserves to uphold property and safety standards. While the club does not serve food or alcohol on-site, it offers bowling leagues and tournaments, promoting community engagement and recreational activities for members and guests. Regular maintenance programs and employee training protocols are in place to ensure operations run smoothly and safely.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Clubs with robust financial statements demonstrating stable cash flow and reserves,
indicating ability to maintain property and safety standards.
– Facilities with comprehensive security measures, including controlled access, surveillance
systems, and trained staff to manage patron safety.
– Operations without on-site alcohol or food service, thereby reducing liquor liability and
foodborne illness exposures.
• Acceptable:
– Facilities offering moderate-risk activities such as golf courses, swimming pools, tennis
courts, and bowling alleys.
– Clubs providing food and/or alcohol service, provided strict controls are in place, includ-
ing trained servers, adherence to local liquor laws, and effective incident reporting.
– Facilities with documented maintenance programs and employee training protocols.
